paite: Ngai un, TOUPA' inn a zan a dingh zel TOUPA sikhate tengteng aw, TOUPA phat un.
heading: Pathian Phat Dia Sapna
english: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!

paite: Na khutte uh mun siangthou lam ah zak unla, TOUPA phat un.
english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise Yahweh!

paite: TOUPA'N Zion a kipan in hon vualzawl hen; lei leh van bawlpa ngei in.
english: May Yahweh bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.
